create.name: Chenrezig Institute
create.bio:
Chenrezig Institute, also called Chenrezig Institute for Wisdom Culture, is a Tibetan Buddhist study and retreat centre set in rainforest on the Blackall Range above Eudlo, in Queensland's Sunshine Coast hinterland. Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche started it in 1974, the year they led their first month-long lam-rim course in Australia, which makes it the country's earliest Tibetan Buddhist centre and the first FPMT centre outside the Indian subcontinent. A Tibetan resident teacher, Geshe Phuntsok Tsultrim of Sera Je, has guided the community since 2014, alongside resident monks and nuns and lay teachers.

The programme runs from guided meditations, centre tours and introductory courses to FPMT's Discovering Buddhism, the In-Depth Meditation Training and the Basic Program, many sessions also open on Zoom. Each January it holds a long lam-rim retreat in a line going back to 1974, and through the year it offers Medicine Buddha, Nyung Nä and Vajrasattva retreats and regular pujas. Visitors can also use its library, art studio, gardens, Dharma shop and vegetarian Big Love Cafe, and stay on site.

courses.title: Path to Peace: Lamrim Retreat with Geshe Tsultrim 2027
courses.description: The centre's yearly residential lam-rim retreat, led by its resident geshe with support from Ven. Tenpa. This year's teachings draw on a short prayer by Lama Tsongkhapa, with time given to the four immeasurables and tonglen.

courses.title: Medicine Buddha Retreat with Ven. Tony Beaumont
courses.description: A three-day retreat built around the Medicine Buddha sadhana and mantra, with teachings on the causes of suffering and on growing compassion for oneself and others.
courses.price: The suggested donation for this retreat is $150

courses.title: Discovering Buddhism - Module 13: Introduction to Tantra - Retreat Weekend
courses.description: The practice weekend of the thirteenth Discovering Buddhism module, taught by Ven. Thubten Pema, giving an overview of the classes of tantra and simple kriya methods. Open only to students who have taken several recent modules.
courses.price: The suggested donation for this two-day weekend course is $120

courses.title: Friday Teaching with Geshe Tsultrim
courses.description: A weekly general talk by the resident geshe, given in Tibetan with an interpreter and suited to newcomers and longer-term students alike, in the gompa or on Zoom.
courses.price: All welcome, no registration required (by donation)
